args.message:
I totalled orders and returns separately, then matched each to a region through its customer. Doing them separately means returns can't inflate the order totals, or the reverse.

| Region | Total ordered | Total returned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| North | 109,334.76 | 2,740.62 |
| South | 104,269.90 | 3,698.96 |
| East | 68,738.70 | 2,418.45 |
| West | 49,151.79 | 1,054.47 |
| Unknown customer or no known region | 1,193.30 | 25.00 |

- **Unknown group:** 16 orders and 2 returns fall here. It covers records whose customer ID doesn't match any customer, plus the one customer who has no known region.
- **Arctic:** this region exists but has no customers, so it isn't listed.
- **Totals check:** the counts add up to all 5,016 orders and 253 returns, so nothing was dropped or counted twice.
